lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern. A primary central row contains approximately 8-10 distinct local maxima spanning from the posterior edge of the gill slits to the mid-trunk.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a regular rectilinear matrix across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to deep-shadow lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs; approximately 2-3 faint, small clusters are visible near the base of the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe truncation of the first dorsal fin apex, characterized by a blunt, irregular superior margin consistent with mechanical trauma. A secondary indentation or tissue loss is visible on the dorsal ridge posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small yellow commensal organism near the pectoral fin and a remora-type fish positioned ventrally below the mid-section.
